context.transcript:
Hello, Felix.
I have two tickets to Thursday night's Modern Dance performance at the Grover Auditorium, but I won't be able to go.
I thought you might like to use them.
Thanks, Colleen.
I'm interested in Modern Dance.
What time does the performance start?
At 8 o'clock.
But keep in mind, it's the first show of the season, so there's always speeches before the performance.
The show probably won't end until 11 p.m.
Oh, that is late.
I'm running a marathon early Friday morning, so I'm afraid I'll have to say no.
I appreciate the offer, though.
context.transcript_translation:
Hello, Felix.
我有两张周四晚上的Modern Dance表演的Grover Auditorium的票，但我不能去了。
我想你可能会喜欢用它们。
谢谢你，Colleen。
我对Modern Dance感兴趣。
演出什么时候开始？
八点。
但请记住，这是本季的第一场演出，所以演出前总会有演讲。
这场戏可能要到晚上11点才结束。
哦，那太晚了。
我周五早上要跑马拉松，所以我恐怕不得不拒绝了。
不过我很感谢你的好意。
